name: El Castillo de las Guardas (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Castillo de las Guardas (a scallop shell above a castle between two lions on green).
history: Municipal flag of El Castillo de las Guardas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
